_doc: The Creation Artifact (see docs/DESIGN.md). starting_lives: lives a new character has. max_lives: cap on stored lives. anchor_slots: realm id -> anchors that can be bound once the player reaches that realm (the highest reached realm listed applies). start_anchor: anchor id bound automatically for a new character. recharge: buying a life costs round(base_cost * cost_growth ^ lives bought so far) spirit stones. respawn: on a violent death with a life left, the player respawns at their most recently bound anchor (the start region if none), losing qi_loss_fraction of current qi while days pass. Anchors are places in data/regions.json with an 'anchor_id' (globally unique).
